class.name: RenderDataRD
class.brief_description: Render data implementation for the RenderingDevice based renderers.
class.description: This object manages all render data for the [RenderingDevice]-based renderers. See also [RenderData], [RenderSceneData], and [RenderSceneDataRD]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal rendering server object. Do not instantiate this class from a script.

method.name: get_directional_light_buffer
method.description: Returns the RenderingDevice uniform buffer containing this view's directional lights, or an invalid RID if no directional lights were submitted. Its layout matches [code]DirectionalLightData[/code] in the renderer's [code]light_data_inc.glsl[/code]. Read it during the current compositor callback, after scene lighting has been prepared. The renderer owns this buffer.

method.name: get_directional_light_index
method.description: Returns the index of [param light] in [method get_directional_light_buffer] for this view, or [code]-1[/code] if it was not submitted. Pass the light resource RID returned by [method VisualInstance3D.get_base] on a [DirectionalLight3D].

method.name: get_directional_shadow_atlas
method.description: Returns the RenderingDevice depth texture containing the directional shadow cascades used by this view, or an invalid RID if no directional shadows are available. Sample it with the corresponding view-space shadow transforms from [method get_directional_light_buffer] during the current compositor callback. The renderer owns this texture.
